description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to your organization's permission-aware knowledge. Synaply searches across connected email, chat, files, code, calendars, CRM records, insights, and people; reads verified source documents; traces decisions and outcomes; and lets users share durable insights for org-wide learning. Results are limited to the authenticated user's workspace permissions.

defaultPrompt: What important decisions were made across my organization this week, and what evidence supports them?
What shipped this month, where did we miss, and what lessons should we carry forward?
